description: Department of Local Government Central Province - Notify the meeting for elect the Chairman of Pathahewaheta Pradesiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the scheduling of a meeting to elect a new Chairman for a local government authority (Pathahewaheta Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a vacancy. It specifically references the Local Government Authorities Election Ordinance and provides election-related details including date, time, and location. This falls under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
